evidence: The diff replaces rt.Registrar.(register.Writer) with machineWriter(), which returns the same value register.Writer{State: register.FileInstallState{}} that machineRuntimes previously placed in Registrar, so behavior is unchanged.
machineRuntimes now calls machineWriter(), so both call sites build the writer from one source and cannot drift apart.
The unchecked type assertion is gone, so the register command no longer panics if machineRuntimes later wraps the Registrar.
No defect was found that this change introduced, activated or worsened.
